n_main.text:
How to use this canvas

• Every phone artboard has two tweaks: Dark theme and Colour (Brand = static scheme from #2563EB, Dynamic = sample Material You scheme from a green wallpaper).
• Shared styles live in project/m3.css — the colour roles map 1:1 to Compose ColorScheme fields, the type classes to MaterialTheme.typography.
• Copy stays as in the app today unless a note says otherwise.

n_signin.text:
Sign in — changes

• Brand header (logo tile + name) and centred, max-width form instead of a bare column.
• Server field gets a status supporting line (Checking / Connected / error) instead of separate text rows.
• SSO is the filled button; password is below an “or” divider with a tonal button.
• Password field gets the show/hide trailing icon (M3 text field guidance).
• Product name is “Home Space” (title case) in the UI; “home-space” stays the repo and code name.

n_files.text:
Files — changes

• Navigation bar with Files / Transfers / Settings replaces the overflow menu (M3: 3–5 top-level destinations go in a navigation bar). Profile moves to the avatar in the top app bar.
• Top app bar: folder name as title, the path as a horizontally scrolling breadcrumb row under it (replaces the drop-down).
• List items follow the M3 two-line list item: 40dp leading icon container, 72dp rows.
• Uploads summary becomes a filled card with a linear progress indicator.
• Selection uses a contextual top app bar + bottom toolbar of icon actions.
• Row ⋮ menu becomes a modal bottom sheet (bigger targets, room for the file header).
• FAB → extended “New” FAB that opens a FAB menu (M3 Expressive) with Upload files / New folder.
• Sync badges keep the desktop semantics (check / sync / error) on the icon container; downloads show inline linear progress instead of a row fill.

n_dialogs.text:
Dialogs — changes

• Simple confirmations stay basic dialogs, with an icon and headline.
• Delete uses an error-coloured confirm button.
• Move becomes a full-screen dialog: a folder picker with breadcrumbs needs more room than an AlertDialog (M3 recommends full-screen dialogs on compact screens for multi-step tasks).

n_more.text:
Search, transfers, settings — changes

• Search uses the M3 search view (full-screen on phones); matches are bold, the location is the supporting line.
• Transfers is a top-level tab: sections with headers, per-item progress and status chips; the badge on the tab counts failures.
• Settings: the Sync switches are directly in the tab (one hop less); the auto-upload folders get their own screen with one card per folder and an “Add folder” FAB.
• Profile: today the page is empty — proposed: account, server, and the devices from GET /devices, with Sign out at the bottom.

Proposals beyond today’s features (drop if unwanted): Appearance section (theme + “Use system colours”), Devices list, New folder inside the Move picker, “Open browser” on the SSO wait screen.
